notes.title: Heart Keeper 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The new update is here, and there are the changes:

1. Settings have been fixed! They're now much clearer and more intuitive.
2. A new enemy, the Dragonfly, has been added! It spawns after wave 16.

Thank you for playing! If you enjoy the game, please don't forget to leave a [b]positive review[/b]. See you!

notes.title: Status Update 1
notes.content:
[b]Good afternoon, everyone![/b]

The release date for Heart Keeper is getting closer, and as you may have noticed, today I finally revealed the release month! In this announcement, I would like to share with you some things I have done since the last update.

Here is what has changed since the last post:
[list]
[*]     A new score system based on how many waves the player has completed and the time taken.
[*]     Steamworks integration, including a working leaderboard based on the new score system.
[*]     Five new types of turrets, including a powerful rocket launcher (which I personally really like, heh).
[*]     Two new enemy types.
[*]     Two different endings for the game.
[/list]

There are still many things left to do, but I will do everything in my power to finish them before the beginning of [b]May[/b]. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45448003/4faefd7d611bdba4d4bb0e0420473aaca4e695a8.gif[/img]
